0022600015.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) visit the Washington Wizards (2-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, 9th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, with Charlotte on a one-game losing streak after a 3-2 stretch over its last five. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), and Dennis Schroder is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), with Tre Johnson day-to-day with Achilles soreness and a game-time decision. Charlotte leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, and the Hornets won all four meetings in 2025-26, while Washington enters on a two-game losing streak.
